items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: And I've got a lot of knowledge from Frank. And that two years or two years and a half experience with him, you see.

ctx.x: Just transpose it. And I've got a lot of knowledge from Frank. And that two years or two years and a half experience with him, you see. So when I went to New Orleans, I was already had improved a lot. You were still playing trumpet, right? Yes. And I had already picked up them finally at the little house, you know. And they really wanted me to stay in New Orleans because I could read fairly good, you see, and all that. And all those guys were sleeping going now, you see.

Oh, yeah. And they needed something to play in New Orleans at that time. Morton wasn't even around then, I guess. He was gone. He wasn't even seen. Gleason wrote in one of the notes, you know, on that, the Django Reinhardt LP. Mm-hmm. Did you study under T.O.? Is that so?
